findings.title: Exercise the real Jeopardy score consumer instead of a copied formula

findings.body: The fixture puts questions in element.questions and names the point value pts, but the existing Jeopardy buildQuestionLookup consumer reads each category.questions and matches question.points. Both fixture categories therefore produce null questions for every cell, so the delivered deck cannot exercise the authored history/science questions in the real board. Move each question into its category using the existing points field before using this fixture as behavioral baseline evidence; otherwise a future renderer test fails because of malformed input rather than the intended feature gap.
findings.title: Use the Jeopardy question schema consumed by the existing board

findings.body: The permanent GREEN assertion requires the confirmed metadata-loss bug to remain present. Adding the missing image longDescription ownership in Phase02 would make this test fail, while continuing to discard every selected image's update passes. Phase01 instead requires a failing-before regression in which the description is applied to both images and survives reload. Record the current empty-update result in baseline evidence, but replace this bug-pinning assertion with the desired two-image authoring/persistence contract and classify its current failure as intentional RED.
findings.title: Assert two-image description persistence rather than preserving its loss

findings.body: The offline test only downloads HTML and searches its source for a literal name. A comment or an unexecuted call would satisfy it while the exported game remained unusable, and a working bundled runtime could omit that exact spelling. It never opens the exported artifact or blocks the network, so it does not cover Phase01's explicit 'network blocked, playable interaction' contract. Replace the source assertion with loading the exported artifact in an offline/network-blocked browser context and performing an interaction with a visible result; capture the present behavioral failure as the offline RED.
findings.title: Verify offline gameplay instead of matching an HTML source string
Test popup interactions and progression rather than button presence
Protect authoring and persistence through the actual editor controls

findings.body: The assembled fixture contains only three distinct game types plus another Name Picker in the vertical child; none of the four fixture files provides actions, an HTML quiz or simulation content. Phase01 implementation step 1 explicitly requires ten game configurations and those additional content families. Consequently the report's full-fixture/full-scope completion claim omits mandated baseline consumers, rather than merely deferring production implementation to later phases. Complete the modular fixture using the existing configurations and add the missing action/HTML quiz/simulation content before accepting the phase.
findings.title: Complete the explicitly required baseline fixture content
Account for and clean up the failed smoke fixture
